title: Three-Level NPC Inverter
description: Three-level neutral-point-clamped (NPC) inverter with sinusoidal PWM (amplitude index 0.8, frequency ratio 20).

source.author: J. Marcos Alonso
source.permission: Adapted and redistributed with the author's permission.
source.note: circuit.qsch is Alonso's schematic; the .cir is the self-contained netlist produced by QSpice/QUX with his behavioral component library embedded.

workflows.title: Three-Level NPC Inverter -- materialize recipe
workflows.summary: Copy the bundled files into the workspace and simulate the self-contained .cir (Track B).
